title: Reacts to familiar voices and sounds
lookFor: Turns head toward caregiver when spoken to
Makes cooing or babbling sounds in response
provenance: Source: ECCD Council Early Learning Guidelines (0-11m)

title: Pushes up on arms during tummy time
lookFor: Lifts head and chest while lying on tummy
Rolls from tummy to back during play
provenance: Source: CDC Milestone Guidelines (0-11m)

title: Explores objects by reaching and grasping
lookFor: Reaches for a toy held within reach
Passes an item from one hand to the other
provenance: Source: ECCD Council Early Learning & Development Standards

title: Smiles and laughs during playful interactions
lookFor: Smiles spontaneously when looking at family members
Enjoys games like peek-a-boo
provenance: Source: CDC Early Social-Emotional Milestones

title: Points to familiar objects when named
lookFor: Points at the ball when you say "ball"
Looks toward a named person
provenance: Source: AAP & CDC Early Communication Guidelines

title: Says one or two simple words
lookFor: Says "mama" or "dada" on purpose
Names a favorite toy
provenance: Source: AAP & CDC Early Communication Guidelines

title: Enjoys a back-and-forth moment during play
lookFor: Passes a toy back and forth with you
Smiles or responds when taking turns
provenance: Source: WHO & UNICEF Nurturing Care Framework

title: Finds a hidden toy
lookFor: Watches where you hide an item under a cloth or cup
Uncovers or reaches directly for the hidden toy
provenance: Source: CDC Developmental Milestones (12-23m)

title: Takes a few steps independently
lookFor: Walks a few paces without holding onto furniture or hands
provenance: Source: CDC Developmental Milestones (12-23m)

title: Uses two-word phrases to express needs
lookFor: Says phrases like "more milk" or "big dog"
Repeats simple words heard during play
provenance: Source: ECCD Council NELF Early Language Framework

title: Jumps with both feet leaving the ground
lookFor: Jumps off a low step with both feet together
Kicks a large ball while maintaining balance
provenance: Source: CDC Toddler Motor Benchmarks

title: Sorts everyday items by color or size
lookFor: Groups red blocks together or pairs shoes
Completes simple 3-piece wooden puzzles
provenance: Source: ECCD Council Early Learning & Development Standards

title: Notices and mirrors other children at play
lookFor: Plays alongside another child with similar toys
Shows awareness when a playmate is smiling or crying
provenance: Source: ECCD Council Social-Emotional Guidelines

title: Asks "who", "what", and "where" questions
lookFor: Asks curious questions about everyday objects
Speaks in sentences of 3 to 4 words
provenance: Source: DepEd Kindergarten & ECCD Council Framework

title: Balances on one foot for a moment
lookFor: Stands on one foot for 2 to 3 seconds
Catches a large bounced ball with two hands
provenance: Source: CDC Preschool Developmental Milestones

title: Identifies familiar colors and counts small sets
lookFor: Names common colors like red, blue, and yellow
Counts up to 3 objects by touching each one
provenance: Source: ECCD Council NELF Cognitive Guidelines

title: Takes turns during simple games with guidance
lookFor: Shares toys when gently reminded
Expresses a wide range of emotions through words
provenance: Source: ECCD Council Social Competence Standards

title: Tells a simple story about their day
lookFor: Describes what happened at playtime in sequence
Uses full sentences with words like "because"
provenance: Source: DepEd MATATAG Curriculum Kindergarten Framework

title: Hops and skips during energetic games
lookFor: Hops forward on one foot several times
Pours water or sand into a cup without spilling
provenance: Source: CDC Early Childhood Motor Guidelines

title: Recognizes some printed letters and numbers
lookFor: Points out familiar letters like the first letter of their name
Draws a person with 3 or more recognizable parts
provenance: Source: DepEd MATATAG Kindergarten Standards

title: Engages in cooperative pretend play with peers
lookFor: Agrees on roles during make-believe games
Comforts a friend or sibling who seems upset
provenance: Source: ECCD Council Early Social Development Standards

title: Retells familiar stories and notices starting sounds
lookFor: Retells a short story with a beginning, middle, and end
Spots everyday words that start with the same sound
provenance: Source: DepEd MATATAG Curriculum - Kindergarten (Literacy)

title: Hops cleanly on one foot and draws basic shapes
lookFor: Hops across a Piko hopscotch grid with steady balance
Draws circles, squares, and simple letters with control
provenance: Source: DepEd MATATAG Curriculum - Kindergarten & CDC 5-year tips

title: Counts up to ten objects and extends simple patterns
lookFor: Counts household items accurately up to 10
Predicts what comes next in an alternating color or shape pattern
provenance: Source: DepEd MATATAG Curriculum - Kindergarten (Numeracy)

title: Follows simple rules and helps with family routines
lookFor: Takes turns fairly during group games
Helps tidy toys or set table items when asked
provenance: Source: DepEd MATATAG Curriculum - Kindergarten & CDC 5-year tips
